metadata.title: 5 Things Investors Need to Know About Wednesday’s Markets

content.text:
Stock futures suggest the Nasdaq and S&P 500 are likely to rise; Nvidia shares are rising after it handed in strong results late Tuesday; Anthropic is expected to finalize IPO share prices today; Target and Lowe's shares are falling during a busy period for retail results; and investors await minutes from the Federal Reserve's last policy meeting.
Here's what to know today:
Stock Futures Point to (Mostly) Higher Open
The Nasdaq and S&P 500 appear poised to bounce back from Tuesday's losses, which came amid anxiety ahead of Nvidia's results. Futures tied to the Nasdaq 100 were recently up 0.6% and futures tied to the S&P 500 were up 0.2%, while those associated with the Dow were down marginally. AI-related stocks were on the rise after Nvidia handed in strong numbers last night (more on that below). Shares of Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), Broadcom (AVGO), Micron (MU) and Marvell Technology (MRVL) were recently up about 2%.
The yield on the 10-year Treasury note was at 5.12%, unchanged from where it closed Tuesday. The price of precious metals was falling, as was the price of bitcoin, which was recently trading just above $64,000, according to CoinDesk. Oil prices were also slipping. West Texas Intermediate, the U.S. oil price benchmark, was recently down 1% to about $85 a barrel.
Nvidia Results Beat Expectations
Nvidia (NVDA) shares were rising in early trading after the company posted strong results on Tuesday evening and raised its outlook. The chip giant beat expectations on the top and bottom lines, with revenue more than doubling over the past year. Nvidia said it doesn't plan to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and signaled that the drama isn't weighing on its outlook by lifting its fourth-quarter earnings growth rate and revenue projections. Nvidia shares plummeted last week as news spread that Huang reportedly had an affair with a Chinese spy, and fell further when he resigned. The stock was up 3% ahead of today's opening bell.
Investors Await Anthropic IPO Pricing
Anthropic plans to finalize share prices this evening for its IPO, and the numbers may top its initial price range, The Wall Street Journal reported. The AI lab is slated to make its trading debut on the Nasdaq this Thursday, with shares trading under the ticker "ANT." Anthropic previously estimated shares would sell for $70 to $78, which would give the company behind Claude a $1.4 trillion valuation. But strong investor demand could lead Anthropic to lift share prices above $80, which would put its valuation closer to $1.5 or $1.6 trillion, The Journal said.
